problem_1.method: semantic logits + A1 empirical midrank + three balanced groups

scoring_definition.logits: binary positive-class softmax; PRRC 0-5 softmax expected rating / 5
scoring_definition.qurater: equal mean of four source ratings within one field
scoring_definition.reference: A1 empirical midrank CDF; A2/A3 reuse A1 map
scoring_definition.length: word count, sentence count, mean word length log1p and cap at A1 p95
scoring_definition.limitations: construct and group weights are modeling choices, not calibrated quality probabilities

conflict.rule: A1 education percentile >= A1 p80 and P(has_ad) > 0.5
conflict.resolution: delta=0.5 only for a sensitivity score; primary Q and Q0 unchanged

mixture_model.holdout_note: absolute loss calibration fails across scales; rank correlation is descriptive, not full predictive transfer
mixture_model.importance_note: sum(b)=0 编码下的平均绝对系数，仅表示相对平均配比域的线性对比强度；非 LightGBM 增益或因果效应
mixture_model.coefficient_coding: sum(b_i)=0; intercept adjusted to preserve predictions

domain_mapping.inferred_handling: 保留配比为解释变量(间接影响其它域Loss)，按体裁相似性赋推断Q并标注低可信度，不无声丢弃

generalized.theta_role: assumed (下游Q3/Q4). B6-B8经验theta仅描述setpoint数据, 见corr_Q_L说明
generalized.corr_Q_L_note: B6-B8 Q_score为实验setpoint(重标定损失), 与Q_synth部署质量口径不同(报告表⑩明确区分)

problem_3.method: SLSQP multi-start feasible search + share-derivative transition; KKT equations analytic only

1e+19.note: Chinchilla等分基线(N=D,Q=Q0无质量投入)，作对照

1e+22.note: Chinchilla等分基线(N=D,Q=Q0无质量投入)，作对照

1e+24.note: Chinchilla等分基线(N=D,Q=Q0无质量投入)，作对照

structural_transition.definition: 候选结构转移=份额对logC导数峰值处(式18)；另检查 Q 边界与 C_Q 铰链状态，未计算 KKT 残差

lctx_sensitivity.note: L_ctx_crit=6/eta=30000 tokens；落在8192与32768之间，即>=32768的长上下文模型注意力开销已超训练开销

problem_4.method: growth-accounting decomp + stratified sigmoid bridge + bootstrap frontier + C8 per-task

contribution_decomp.interpretation: 年份系数=12.1 点/年是控制参数量后的条件关联；窗口 ΔlnN=-0.27，份额为模型拟合增量之比，不能解释为因果贡献

bridge.map_error_note: 残差反映 Loss 到 Cap 的映射误差；直接从榜单 Cap 外推的前沿预测不使用该桥接

frontier.method: monthly P90 envelope + residual-bootstrap slope refit and predictive noise
frontier.scenario_note: 情景系数0/0.5/1直接缩放历史能力前沿斜率；与训练算力增速的对应关系是假设，未由数据估计
frontier.compute_cagr_note: C4(Epoch AI)训练算力中位数 2019-2025 增速 5.10×/年，仅作情景背景；未拟合算力-能力弹性
frontier.prediction_interval_note: 各情景内 P10/P90 包含历史趋势斜率估计和月度前沿残差的不确定性；不包含情景选择或桥接误差
frontier.extrapolation_note: 12/24月为情景模拟，含外推不确定性，非数据直接支持

c8_aggregation.coverage_note: 覆盖 1860 可解析目录(>=1800要求), 六维完整 1854
